question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Peace
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Peace"** means a state of tranquility or quiet; freedom from disturbance or conflict. (शांति)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of war, the country finally experienced** peace.**
 
 
 
• **"Turmoil" **refers to a state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty. (अशांति)
 
 
• **Example: **The stock market was in **turmoil** after the unexpected news.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Peace' **is **'Turmoil'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Refusal **(अस्वीकृति): The act of refusing or denying.

 
 
• **Example:** His **refusal** to cooperate made the situation worse.
 
 
 
• **Strange **(अजीब): Unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain.
 
 
• **Example: **He had a **strange** feeling that something was wrong.
 
 
 
• **Harmony** (सामंजस्य): The combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce chords and chord progressions having a pleasing effect.
 
 
• **Example:** They lived together in perfect **harmony.**
